diagnosis_completion_rules.converged_branch: complete_native_matrix_and_independent_reconstruction; latest valid adjacent pair on each tested axis including followup parent pair has all 54 components <=2%; outcome is limited to tested settings and is not absolute accuracy
diagnosis_completion_rules.nonconverged_branch: complete_native_matrix_and_independent_reconstruction; at least one latest valid 54-component pair remains >2% after followup; identify limiting condition and interpret controlled followup
diagnosis_completion_rules.insufficient_branch: missing run, matrix pair, execution ownership, supported solver, independent reconstruction, sealed followup plan, or unresolved numeric comparison
diagnosis_completion_rules.latest_pair_rule: classify each axis using its latest valid adjacent pair; coarse earlier pairs may exceed 2%; if followup resolves a prior exceedance, do not retain DEMONSTRATED_NOT_CONVERGED on that basis alone
diagnosis_completion_rules.followup_parent_rule: coupled_fit_mesh compares mesh-3 to followup-5; effective_window compares window-2 to followup-5 at matching mesh/profile; if followup changes mesh, do not extrapolate the original mesh-3 window result
diagnosis_completion_rules.if_both_axes_pass: the evaluator derives the expected target as the global maximum among 108 deltas (54 per axis), applies a stable channel/concentration/direction tie-break, verifies the candidate plan selected that target, and seals the plan; a mismatch is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

evaluator_disposition.meaning: scientific diagnosis may be INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE while evaluator disposition is ENVIRONMENT_ERROR_NO_REWARD; no reward is emitted
